name: Parallel Coordinates
summary: Multi-criteria screening: one vertical axis per metric, one line per company; brush ranges on any axis to cross-filter the rest of the report.
summary_zh: 多指标筛选：每个指标一条纵轴、每家公司一条折线；在任意轴上拖选区间即可交叉筛选报告中的其他图表。
description_zh: 用于同业筛选与多维对比：把估值倍数、利润率、增长、杠杆、股东回报等 4–8 个数值字段并排成纵轴（各轴沿用字段格式，可单独 inverse 让“越低越好”的指标朝上），每家公司是一条穿过各轴的折线。目标公司以 accent-2 粗线置顶，虚线为同业中位数，其余公司可按行业 / 地区着色（图例可开关）。在轴上拖动即可框选区间，多轴条件取交集，被选中的公司名会作为 'in' 筛选条件同步到其他组件（如可比公司表、散点图）；点击轴上空白处清除该轴框选。
best_for: Screening a peer set on 4–8 metrics at once
Showing trade-offs (growth vs. margin vs. leverage)
Interactive peer-group selection that drives the comps table
avoid_when: Audiences unfamiliar with the chart in a printed deck (static reading is hard)

label.desc: Row name (company) — tooltip title and the cross-filter field

color.desc: Category field colouring the peer lines (one legend entry each)

target.desc: Flag field marking the target line

dims.desc: Axes: field names or {field, title, format, inverse, min, max}; string fields become category axes; [] = first 6 numeric fields

highlight.desc: Label value(s) drawn in accent-2 on top (in addition to rows flagged by encode.target)

median.desc: Dashed peer-median line (target excluded; mode on category axes)

brush.desc: Publish brushed rows as a cross-filter ('in' on encode.label)

format.desc: Fallback axis format for fields without one

legend.desc: Legend (colour groups, target, peer median); click to toggle

interactions: Drag on any axis to brush a range (several axes = AND)
Brushed companies cross-filter every other block with the label field (crossFilterScope: 'dataset' keeps it to this dataset); a brush that catches no company shows an empty selection
Click an axis outside the brush to clear it; external filter reset clears brushes
Hover a line: all metrics formatted

samples.title: Peer screening — valuation, profitability, growth, leverage
Peers by region — target vs. muted peer set
